item.text: The desktop is using GNOME Terminal profiles. I found the active default profile UUID, so I’m going to set that profile’s initial columns and rows directly in dconf/gsettings.
The profile was still at the stock 80x24. I’m applying 132 columns and 43 rows now, then I’ll read it back to confirm it persisted in the settings database.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'profile="org.gnome.Terminal.Legacy.Profile:/org/gnome/terminal/legacy/profiles:/:$(gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.ProfilesList default | tr -d "'"')/\"
gsettings set \""'$profile" default-size-columns 132
gsettings set "$profile" default-size-rows 43
gsettings get "$profile" default-size-columns
gsettings get "$profile" default-size-rows'

/bin/bash -lc 'profile="org.gnome.Terminal.Legacy.Profile:/org/gnome/terminal/legacy/profiles:/:$(gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.ProfilesList default | tr -d "'"')/\"
